name: measuring-tape-hover
title: Measuring Tape Hover
description: Hover any word and a measuring tape slides out beneath it showing its rendered width in px and ch — a debugging instrument for kerning obsessives, implemented with real getBoundingClientRect measurement per word.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Hover Measure: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
